description: Convert a LogEst (about 10 * log2 of a row estimate, stored in an i16) back to an integer (sqlite3LogEstToInt)
notes: SQLite 3.46.1, sqlite3LogEstToInt (src/util.c), with LogEst = int16_t and LARGEST_INT64 = 0x7fffffffffffffff. Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: sdiv and srem by 10, selects for the mantissa adjustment, branches for the overflow cap and for the shift direction: 25 IR instructions. A negative remainder converts to a large u64 as in SQLite, and large negative inputs make the right-shift amount exceed 63 (UB in the source). Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
